rules.name: is_visible
rules.rule: node != 0 && node[+ACh] > 0.0f; COMISS/JBE, so NaN is not visible

rules.name: set_visible
rules.rule: ancestor chain AND of virtual +38h with an early break; then the five-argument walk seeded (ok, ok, visible, widget+75h, 1); then node factor 1.0 or 0.0 with recurse = widget+75h. The walk runs before the factor is written, so it observes the old value.

rules.name: propagate_visibility
rules.rule: no node stops the walk including children; before = a1 && virtual+38h; after = a2 ? (a5 ? a3 : virtual+38h) : false; fire virtual +3Ch only on the edge; child receives (before, after, a3, a4, a4 ? a5 : 0)

uncertainties: widget+E4h is written by neither constructor: 00aa9390 and 00aa9520 both stop at +E0h, so a layout that omits Visible calls SetVisible on uninitialised memory unless a derived constructor writes it. No derived constructor was read.
+85h named Active from three uses in one class only; it may be that class's state living in a base-class hole.
node+138h bits 1h and 2h are cleared on every bind and set nowhere in the GUI; their meaning belongs to the scene packets.
The GUI's root scene node, layer or camera was not identified; the parent chain is the only placement recovered.
The node class behind virtual +10h is unidentified, so reading it as clone-with-name rests on the argument being a per-type name string from 00d5c0b8.
The self-assignment of the clone's Pos at 00aab53a..00aab55b is reproduced as a no-op; a volatile or aliasing reading cannot be excluded from the listing.
00aa9730's block at 00aa97ac..00aa97d2 is unreachable because 00aa8320 already cleared +4Ch; read as an inlined base-class body.
The base class above the two leaf vtables was not mapped; 00aa9520 stores 00ceb130 then 00d5c130.

00aa9730 keeps its placeholder ledger name: an earlier packet recorded a false no-return truncating the stored body at 00aa9950 with the real RET at 00aa99b8, so only the head was read here. The existing 00aa9390 record names the base constructor BSP_UIContext_Construct while this packet names everything BSP_GuiWidget_*; the inconsistency is unresolved.
